title: Make Halves, Thirds, and Fourths PLC Activity

stageA.sourceMathematics: A half is ONE of2 equal-area pieces, a third ONE of3 equal-area pieces, and a fourth ONE of4 equal-area pieces. Different shapes are acceptable when each SHARE has equal area.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original Activity1 learners FOLD rectangular paper into2/4/3 EQUAL-area pieces, CUT, label pieces and compare with partner. Unequal areas are not thirds even if three pieces exist.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Source warmup figures and real folds/cuts require human equality-of-area assessment, not piece count only.
